context: Dashcam footage from a car driving at a steady speed along a city avenue behind a red sedan. Preserve the camera viewpoint, the road geometry, the lane markings, and the position, size and motion of every vehicle exactly; do not add or remove vehicles, signs, poles or obstacles.
